Text: STYLE "STAMMTISCH-COMIC" - copy the style of the reference picture(s) exactly: a chaotic, crazy 1980s-90s German humour comic-book look. Thick, wobbly, energetic black ink lines with lots of scratchy hatching and cross-hatching in the shadows. Very saturated, bright, slightly gaudy colours - fire-engine red, cobalt blue, egg-yolk yellow, grass green, pink flesh - with rich marker-like gradients and white highlights. Busy and dense, packed with funny little details. CHARACTER RULES (always the same, only the body proportions change): a huge round bulbous pink-red potato nose, big white oval eyes with small black pupils and heavy lids, a wide mouth with big blocky white teeth or a gap-tooth grin, big floppy ears, ruddy cheeks and stubble, big four-fingered hands, huge clompy boots, wild scruffy spiky hair. Bodies pushed to extremes (beanpole-skinny and gangly, or barrel-round and pot-bellied, tiny and squat, or huge). WORLD RULES: buildings, trees, rocks and objects drawn with the same wobbly ink, slightly crooked and bulging. AVOID: clean vector look, smooth digital shading, pastel or muted colours, yellow or sepia tint, generic AI cartoon look, anime, 3D. No text, no letters, no logos, no signature anywhere.
Notes: ROUND AM. Starts EVERY OpenAI prompt. Then add SUBJECT: ... (what to draw). Reference images: art_source/style_refs/stammtisch/board_characters.png for people and creatures, board_places.png for places, buildings and objects (plus a sketch for a pose, if there is one).
